content.short: A premier Bitcoin NFT marketplace and social platform powered by Stacks, enabling Bitcoin-settled digital ownership.
content.description:
Gamma.io is a leading marketplace for Bitcoin NFTs, utilizing the Stacks layer to enable smart contract functionality that settles on the Bitcoin network. It provides a native venue for the Bitcoin Ordinals ecosystem and Stacks-based collectibles. The platform features a creator launchpad, empowering artists to mint 100% creator-owned projects with ease while ensuring long-term provenance on the secure Bitcoin blockchain.

Gamma.io also offers a social experience connecting collectors through decentralized identity. User profiles allow for the consolidation of multiple wallets, providing a unified view of digital assets while bridging Bitcoin with Web3 programmability.
content.meta: Buy, sell, and mint Bitcoin NFTs on Gamma.io. Discover a social marketplace for digital collectibles powered by Stacks and Bitcoin security.
